title.narrative: PIMS 10381 - URU/25/011 Enhancing the governance of gender-responsive climate change adaptation and mitigation planning and financing in key sectors and territories in Uruguay

description.narrative: The project aims to strengthen national capacities to integrate gender equality into climate change planning and climate-related financial instruments at both territorial and sectoral levels. It will develop guidelines, tools, communication materials and participatory mechanisms, while generating data to promote women’s economic empowerment and resilience in the context of climate action. The Government of Uruguay (GoU) has made significant progress in catalyzing institutional leadership in response to climate change and developing a process of gender mainstreaming in its national climate change policy. Despite progress, there are remaining gaps such as (i) limited decentralization in gender climate governance, which restricts local engagement and the integration of gender considerations in climate planning and finance, (ii) a lack of gender-responsive financial mechanisms to support women-led initiatives in transitioning to lowcarbon, climate-resilient development, (iii) insufficient access to assets, finance and capacities for women-led associations and businesses to effectively accessclimate finance, and (iv) a lack of gender-disaggregated climate information and guidelines, hindering gender-responsive planning, implementation and strategic financial decision-making.The relevance of this Readiness request is grounded in recent feedback from national and subnational stakeholders during the construction of the second Gender and Climate Change Action Plan (PAG CC), including the National Institute of Women (Inmujeres), sectoral actors and local governments, who confirmed the validity of the challenges and the need to scale up support.
